summary: Expanded the US-accessible universe around advanced glass, low-dielectric glass fiber, and high-speed PCB/substrate materials. The reference anchor is Nitto Boseki, whose specialty glass/T-glass exposure appears closest to the bottleneck. The underfollowed discovery lane points to Nippon Electric Glass, AGC, and Rogers as adjacent or second-order beneficiaries through low-dielectric glass fiber, CCL/PCB materials, glass-core/semiconductor materials, and low-loss laminates. Evidence strength is uneven: Nitto and NEG have the most direct glass-fiber support; AGC and Rogers are plausible adjacent chokepoints requiring customer qualification and revenue-mix verification.
